messages:
elen_sales: FYI - VeritasAI signed the NDAs and wants a 90m perf validation next Mon. Scope: smoke, sustained, multi-model routing, and a couple of high-concurrency bursts. Need a shareable runbook + quick hosted vs Dedicated pricing + short blurb for their security about SOC2 and data residency. Can someone own ops/runbook?

ash_se: I'll run the experiment. Their workload: mixed conversational endpoints + classification. Avg request: 320 tokens in, 120 tokens out for chat; classification is short (<30 tokens). Plan outline: smoke 10m@10qps (chat only), sustained 40m mixed traffic ~120qps (75% chat / 25% classify), then 4 ramped microbursts 45s->250qps peak (blend routing: 60% chat 40% classify) spaced 3m apart. Also include a model-fallback exercise: route to redwood-compat-small when redwood-xl latency degrades.

min_ops: Ops checklist: Dedicated pool recommended for consistent p99 during the 250qps peaks. Hosted can handle the steady mixed workload but needs burst pre-warms and a 2x burst capacity. Request their IP ranges, preferred region (we should run in us-west2), and whether they need keys in their KMS. If they insist on EU-only data residency, we'll need private deployment conversation.

sam_eng: Can we give them a tiny harness + curl examples? Also want to exercise cold path for chat (KV cache disabled) and a warm path for classification. I'll monitor p50/p95/p99 and tail traces.

ash_se: Curl sample for chat load (provide test key):

```
POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/chat
Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"redwood-xl-1.0","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize: <SAMPLE_DOC>"}],"max_tokens":140}
```

To force cold: header `X-RW-KV-Cache: false`. For model-fallback test set header `X-RW-Fallback: redwood-compat-small`. Harness will submit mixed proportions and flip headers accordingly.

elen_sales: Pricing snapshot request from buyer: assume ~250k gen tokens across runs + 1 day of eng support. Need hosted per-token BEO and Dedicated small cluster day-rate. Also they asked about SOC2 and EU residency note.

min_ops: Hosted BEO: gen tokens ~ $0.00038/token -> 250k ~= $95. Ops/support for the run (scheduling, monitoring, extra logs) ~= $200. Dedicated: reserved 2-GPU small pool day-rate ~= $900/day (covers pre-warm + ops). Private/EU-only sizing starts with a quote (depends on infra). SOC2: we provide certificate and can enable token logging redaction; for EU residency note we can run in EU region or offer Private (on-prem/VPC) for stricter controls.

sam_eng: I'll enable trace sampling 1% and token-level metrics for the window. Also enable rtail p50/p95/p99 and histogram buckets for response sizes. If p99 > 2.5s during bursts we auto-scale to two extra nodes.

deploy-bot: perf-harness v2.1 deployed to perf cluster by @deploy-bot

elen_sales: Great. I'll send the buyer the proposed timetable (UTC window + ask for IP ranges, region preference, and KMS contact) and the pricing snapshot. I'll cc legal for SOC2 certs. Thanks team :thumbsup:
